definition: Responsibility for having done something wrong or harmful.
author: Matthew Gregory Lewis
quote: He found the Cardinal-Duke; and represented to him the supposed culpability of the Prioress, as also the violent effects which it had produced upon Don Raymond.
example_sentence: The company refused to accept any culpability for the leak.
